item.text:
Introduced [`SimulationContext`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationContext.java>) as the central owner of shared simulation services and configuration. It now holds the `RandomProvider`, `SimulationConfig`, `DiseaseService`, `WeatherService`, and `MovementService`, and also tracks the bootstrapped `Field`, `OrganismFactory`, and `ActorService`. That gives the codebase one service graph instead of passing those dependencies around piecemeal.

I rewired the main constructors around that context:
- [`Field.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Field.java>) now takes a `SimulationContext` and exposes it via `getSimulationContext()`.
- [`Environment.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Environment.java>), [`OrganismFactory.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/OrganismFactory.java>), and [`ActorService.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/ActorService.java>) now depend on the context instead of individual services.
- [`Organism.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Organism.java>) and the concrete organism hierarchy now read shared dependencies from the context rather than using `Field` as a service locator.
- [`Simulator.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java>) now bootstraps the simulation by creating the context once, then wiring `Field`, `OrganismFactory`, `ActorService`, and `Environment` through it.

I also updated state/statistics code to read disease state through the context path rather than old `Field` service getters, including [`SimulationState.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationState.java>) and [`FieldStats.java`](</Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/FieldStats.java>).

Verification: `javac *.java` passed.
